newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria budget deficit falls to 446 bln levs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria budget deficit falls to 446 bln levs.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit fell by some 39.18 billion levs in the first half of June to 446.04 billion levs, a Finance Ministry official said, citing preliminary figures.
"The deficit stood at 446.04 billion levs on June 17," the official told Reuters, declining to comment on the reasons for the fall.
Deficit at mid-June was around 2.76 percent of the nominal 1997 gross domestic product (GDP) of 16.15 trillion levs assumed in this year's budget yet to be finalised by parliament.

Central government budget deficit for the fiscal 1997, which in Bulgaria coincides with the calendar year was projected at 6.2 percent of GDP with revenues seen at 27.3 percent of GDP and expenditures at 33.5 percent.
Budget revenues at mid-June amounted to 819.89 billion levs or 5.08 percent of projected GDP against expenditures of 1,265.93 billion levs or 7.84 percent of GDP. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
